objectClass.notes: One piece of the ELEVATED EXPRESSWAY set, built to the modular contract in the registry notes: every pier carries its bearing seat at y = 12.00, every deck module is 12.5 m wide along X and 16 m long along Z with its pivot at the SOFFIT centre, so a deck placed at y = 12 sits on any pier and two modules meeting over one butt at z = +-8 clear of its cap. Nothing opens, turns or swings; nothing attaches. One root pivot and zero sockets is the whole contract, and the end faces are flat and square so chained pieces never z-fight. The standard Bangkok elevated deck (Sirat, Chalerm Maha Nakhon): pale precast segments with joints every ~2.7 m, rust weeps from the parapet joints, exhaust soot on the upper webs, a drain pipe slung along one cantilever, dark asphalt with a yellow edge line and white dashed lane lines.

reasoning: Four components on four materials, 4 draw calls of 24: the slab-and-parapets sweep, the box sweep, the asphalt sweep, the pipe.
Two concrete materials so the box can wrap its tile once round its profile (soot on the upper webs) while the slab tile keys its joints along the road.
No repetition system: the collars are three cylinders in the pipe merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, a derived compound, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the section -- a trapezoidal box under a cantilevered slab with parapets -- and the road on it. All four are closed profile sweeps, so the section is exact at every station; joints, soot, rust and lane lines are canvas.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 12.50 x 3.50 x 16.00 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=32000 triangles, <=24 draw calls, <=16 materials, <=32 unique geometries.

Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The rigid body of the prop at its declared origin. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it, and only real mechanisms get one.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.
actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

silhouette.description: A 12.5 x 3.5 section: 7 m soffit, webs sloping out to a 12.5 m slab with 0.40 parapets to 3.50, asphalt at 2.40; 16 m long with vertical ends; a 0.28 m pipe under the +X edge.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-6.25: the parapets' outer faces, the contract deck width. y 0..3.50: the SOFFIT (the pivot, placed on a pier seat at 12) to the parapet top; road at 2.40, slab top 2.35, box top 2.05, cantilever edge underside 2.12. z +-8: the 16 m module with vertical end faces. Box 7 m at the soffit, webs to +-4.65 at 2.05; parapets 0.40 thick with a 0.15 kerb kick.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Meshy v7 proxy (scratch/expressway-box-girder-deck-module/reference.glb) normalises the 16 m module to its height and is read for the SECTION only (box narrower than the slab, sloping webs, parapet proportion); the plan is the contract. The band table (w 1.44 H) is not a proportion check on a contract-fixed module.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. The far parapet and web repeat the near ones by the section's symmetry; the drain pipe is on one side only, as the plate shows.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. 310/32,000 triangles, 4/24 draw calls, 4/16 materials, 4/32 unique geometries, three canvases.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero4x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: 4 component(s) + 0 repetition system(s) = 4 of 24. Parts that share a material ride one merged geometry and one submission.

materials.note: 4 of 16: every tone inside a material is a vertex colour or a canvas ratio over its envelope, never a second material.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 310 of 32000, measured off the built module by render-model.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes, extruded (x, y) profiles and profile SWEEPS along a straight, sheared or arced path merged per material; cylinders where the plate shows a round section.
No InstancedMesh: nothing on this piece repeats enough to earn one. In a level the HOST instances the whole module.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. Surface identity is one post-construction canvas tile per material -- cast concrete with a form-tie grid, lift lines and pinholes; asphalt with its lane marks; painted steel with rust -- bound as map and bump after construction, so createObjectModel does no per-pixel work but the tiles.

risks.description: The proxy normalises a long module to its height; the band table cannot check the plan.
risks.mitigation: The plan is the contract; the section is read from the proxy and plate.
